item.title: macOS Golden Gate 27
item.description:
Must-read for users

If your Mac wasn't upgraded from a macOS 27 beta, the apps you're running may still be older builds from before the official release. Early in the macOS 27 beta some apps failed to launch or had compatibility problems; these have since been fixed and working versions re-uploaded. macOS 27 tightens TCC privacy permission checks. You can use the built-in Console app to view live system logs: search for kTCCServiceSystemPolicyAppDataDetailed (or kTCCServiceSystemPolicyAppData if nothing turns up). If the log shows denials for the target app reading a protected directory such as ~/Library/Group Containers/, the app is usually being blocked by TCC privacy restrictions.

item.title: Adobe Activation Tool 1.2.9/2.1.7
item.description:
Activation tool / patch for the Adobe suite

Adobe Activation Tool is a universal activation tool for the Adobe suite on macOS. It supports recent versions of Photoshop, Premiere Pro, Illustrator, After Effects, Acrobat DC, Lightroom Classic, InDesign, the Substance 3D series and more. You just run the program and pick the matching version when prompted. It suits offline environments or users who hit activation limits, and lets people use the full Adobe creative suite without a subscription.

item.title: Pocket Screen 2.1.1
item.description:
picture-in-Picture Window Sticky Tool for macOS

Pocket Screen – Window PiP is a window-in-picture tool for macOS that transforms Mac app windows into a compact, live, suspended reference view that makes documents, tutorials, videos, web pages, and dashboards continuously visible while working on other tasks, reducing back-and-forth switching while working on a single monitor. The software supports up to four independent reference views, and can also create multiple views from the same source window to freeze and retain information on different tabs or stages of operation. With Area Focus, you can display and magnify only what you need to focus on; each view is free to move, resize, and independently set transparency and update quality. Click Penetrate to directly manipulate the window below the floating view, and the reference view arrangement function makes it easy to restore the neat layout. The software offers energy-efficient, standard, smooth, and Ultra quality modes, with Ultra reaching up to 60 frames per second in 4K on supported Macs. Users can also customize shortcuts to quickly add, toggle, close, or temporarily hide views and exclude picture-in-picture from screenshots, recordings, and screen sharing in supported versions of the system.

item.title: MarkSide 1.0.0
item.description:
macOS Dual Column Markdown Editor

MarkSide is a two-column Markdown editor for macOS. The Markdown source code is displayed side by side with the formatted document, and can be directly edited on both sides. When the cursor is moved, the corresponding position is also displayed on the other side, which is convenient to check the syntax and reading effect at the same time. When editing, only the actual input is modified, the original line breaks, character encoding, indentation, and writing habits such as using asterisks or underscores to indicate italics are retained, and other parts of the document are not rewritten. The software provides formatting tools such as bold, italics, links, titles, lists, task lists, references, code blocks, and tables, and also supports Markdown shortcut input. It recognizes the extensions used by the document and displays the compatibility of the CommonMark, GitHub, Pandoc, MultiMarkdown, and Obsidian dialects; it can be converted to Markdown when pasting content from Word, a browser, or an AI chat window, and will be asked first when information may be lost. YAML front matter, footnotes and notes are rendered in editable cards.

item.title: Backup Atlas 1.0.0-beta.14
item.description:
macOS Time Machine TimeMachine Backup Management

Backup Atlas is a Time Machine backup viewing and monitoring tool for macOS that directly reads existing backups, helps users understand file changes and retrieve content still stored in backups by changing timelines, file searches, and version comparisons. The main interface displays the time when the most recent backup was completed, the weekly backup changes, and the recently deleted and modified documents. It also merges and displays the changes generated by the project or bulk import, reducing browsing interference. Users can view the file version history, compare the text and code line by line, view pictures and common office documents side by side, and then restore the desired version to the specified folder; files with different names will be renamed to avoid overwriting. Menu bar monitoring can alert you that backups are overdue, disks are inaccessible, repeated failures or stagnation, and desktop widgets are synchronized. The software also alerts you to the risk that some documents that have been deleted or only exist in iCloud will have their last backup copy about to be cleaned up.

item.title: TabPug 1.11
item.description:
Mac native AI autocomplete writing assistant

TabPug is a native AI input completion tool for macOS that predicts follow-up text based on what you're typing and displays suggestions near the cursor in macOS-enabled accessibility apps like Mail, Slack, Notion, Notes, and Browser. Press Tab to accept the next word, Shift Tab to insert the entire suggestion, ignore, close or undo the completion, and shortcut keys to support customization. The software understands the reply context by reading the original text of the email or the chat content on the screen, provides functions such as text fragment expansion, facial expression name completion, and authorization to fill in personal information from the address book. Users can take the initiative to start writing style learning, so that the suggestions are adapted to the wording habits in different applications, and the learning content is encrypted and saved locally and can be viewed and deleted. Built-in model recommendation and battery strategy, you can switch between lightweight models or pause operation when the battery is powered according to the device selection model. After the model is downloaded, it supports offline completion, no need to register an account, and the input content is not uploaded to the server. At the same time, it supports deactivation by application or website, always skipping the password box, and does not provide suggestions in the code editor by default.

item.title: BassEducation Metronome 1.1
item.description:
Mac Instrument Practice Metronome

BassEducation Metronome is a professional metronome that combines daily rhythm training, band rehearsals, and live performances, created by touring bassist Damian Erskine, and supports macOS 14.0 and above. The software uses a large speed dial as the operating core, which can be dragged to adjust the speed, step by step, switch half speed or double speed, and also set the speed by tapping. In addition to regular beats, odd and compound beats such as 5/4, 7/8, and 9/8 are also supported, allowing you to set strong accents, light accents, or mute on a beats-by-beats basis, and independently mix positron, eighth note, sixteenth note, and triplet. Users can select sounds such as wooden fish, sand hammer, drum rack, prompt tone and voice beat, adjust the pitch and volume of the sound, and build personalized beats with rocking rhythms. Practice coaches provide training methods such as fast or slow bars, random mute bars, etc., to help exercise speed control and internal rhythm. Pro Modes provides rhythm libraries, performance track lists, and live modes to save song beat configurations and call them in performance order; Mac stage windows support temporary tap speed measurement and fine-tuning without changing saved settings.

item.title: Fader 0.22.1
item.description:
Open Source Mac Audio Management Tool

Fader is a native menu bar audio management tool for macOS that centralizes output device switching, app independent volume, multi-device playback, and microphone control in one interface. You can toggle between headphones, speakers, monitor audio, and AirPlay targets at the touch of a button, connect directly to paired Bluetooth headsets, and automatically toggle priority by dragging device sorting settings. The software supports the simultaneous playback of multiple output devices, each with its own volume slider; the volume, mute, and preserve settings can also be adjusted separately for sounding applications, or the specified application can be assigned to one or more output devices, while the rest of the applications continue to use the main output. When the volume is at full capacity, the audio is unmodified and supports perfect playback. The microphone function toggles the default input, adjusts the gain, and sees the applications that are using the microphone, while the system volume is synchronized with the volume keys and the control center. Fader uses the mit open source license, does not collect telemetry data, and does not require kernel extensions or virtual audio drivers; when the application volume function is used for the first time, the system audio recording permission is required, and the captured audio is processed only locally.

item.title: Filetor 0.1.7
item.description:
Mac 2-Column File Manager

Filetor is a macOS open source two-column file manager developed using Swift and SwiftUI for users who frequently organize, move, and compare files between folders, disks, and network drives. It organizes your browsing space in a side-by-side duplex with separate tabs, supports list, icon, and column views, and provides subfolder searching, quick preview of spaces, and session recovery for browsing. The sidebar focuses on favorites, mounted disks, cloud storage, and web servers, with progress prompts and conflict handling across panel drag-and-drop, copy, and move operations. For complex finishing tasks, the software has built-in real-time preview for batch renaming, duplicate file lookup, folder difference comparison, and one-way or two-way synchronization. When synchronizing, you can adjust the direction one by one, and the replaced files will be moved to the wastebasket. Users can also compress and extract files, rotate and convert images, modify file times, quickly invoke commands through action searches and shortcuts, and customize toolbars, color schemes, font sizes, and list layouts. Filetor requires macOS 14 or later, is open source under the mit license, is still in the early stages of development, and should be backed up before handling important files.

item.title: OnlySwitch release_3.6.0
item.description:
Menu Bar System Switches Collection

OnlySwitch is a powerful macOS menu bar application that provides a series of switches designed to simplify the user's daily workflow, such as hiding desktop icons, switching dark mode, and hiding the grooves of the new MacBook Pro. The user can easily control these functions in the status bar, and the displayed switches and shortcuts can be customized as needed. Since version 1. As of 7, users can import custom shortcuts into OnlySwitch and support keyboard shortcuts from version 2.0. The app also supports Apple widgets, which allow users to place relevant switches and buttons on their desktops or notification centers for quick and easy access. OnlySwitch supports switching between various macOS browsers, keeping users' browsing history and allowing users to add or remove features based on their needs. The software comes with a 30-day free trial and can be installed via Homebrew or downloaded manually. OnlySwitch is a powerful menu bar app designed to streamline users' daily workflows, such as hiding desktop icons, switching between dark modes, and hiding the bangs of the new MacBook Pro.

item.title: MiaoYan 4.9.0
item.description:
macOS Native Markdown Editor

MiaoYan is a lightweight Markdown laptop app designed to help users easily write beautiful sentences. It features purely local use for security while supporting features such as syntax highlighting, dark mode, and automatic document layout. Users can enjoy a minimalistic three-column design that includes folders, file lists, and an editor for a great visual experience. MiaoYan uses Swift5 for native development, outperforms traditional web applications, and provides a number of shortcuts to improve editing efficiency. Other features include document export, internal jumps, graph bed support, and support for LaTeX, Mermaid, PlantUML, and Markmap brainstorming, making it a versatile writing tool.

item.title: Bing Wallpaper 2.0.28.0
item.description:
macOS free wallpaper app

The Bing Wallpaper app lets you explore the world through a single image every day. Downloading this app will bring your desktop to life every day with beautiful images from around the world that have been featured on the background of Bing's homepage. This not only allows you to see different landscapes in front of your computer every day, but also allows you to browse through these pictures and learn where they come from, allowing you to gain insight and experience different cultures and nature while using your computer on a daily basis. Bring new life to your desktop every day by downloading Bing Wallpaper. Bing Wallpaper offers a selection of beautiful images from around the world that were featured on Bing's homepage. Not only will you see a new image on your desktop every day, but you'll also be able to browse through the images and learn where they came from. Discover a new place every day to bring your desktop to life.

item.title: Cherry Studio 2.2.0
item.description:
Customize your own AI assistant

Cherry Studio is a Windows, Mac, and Linux-compatible desktop client that supports multiple major language model (LLM) providers. It not only integrates cloud services such as OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic, but also supports the deployment of Ollama and LM Studio native models. Users can use the built-in 300 + preconfigured AI assistants, or custom create a dedicated assistant to talk to multiple models at the same time and get diverse perspectives. At the same time, the app supports a variety of document formats, including text, pictures, Office, and PDF, with WebDAV file management and data backup capabilities. Cherry Studio also provides useful tools such as global search, topic management, AI-driven translation, and ensures a quality experience with light and dark themes and transparent windows that can be used out of the box without additional configuration. Users who like Cherry Studio can support its development through Little Star or sponsored developers.

item.title: LanFi 4.12.1
item.description:
macOS Open Source WiFi Analysis Tool

LanFi is a native macOS Wi-Fi analysis tool that scans nearby wireless networks based on the Apple CoreWLAN framework, transforming signal strength, signal-to-noise ratio, channel overlap, utilization, and security configurations into interpretable quality scores to help users determine connection status and troubleshoot wireless network issues. The software supports Wi-Fi 4 to Wi-Fi 7 recognition, providing 2. 4, 5, and 6 GHz frequency band charts and sorted channel suggestions can detect risks related to open network, WEP, legacy WPA, WPS, and management frame protection, and give severity and repair tips. The built-in diagnostic engine covers wireless links, IPv4 and IPv6, gateways, DNS, portal authentication, HTTPS, and latency checking in conjunction with signal history and continuous monitoring for location failures. Users can also view underlying protocol fields, analyze offline packet capture files, collect data through SSH remote sensors, import floorplans to generate signal heatmaps, and manage survey results using groupings, tags, notes, and saved sessions.

item.title: MotrixNext 4.1.2
item.description:
Lightweight Download Manager

Motrix Next is a full-featured download manager from zero refactoring, based on Tauri 2 Rust backend, Vue 3 Composition API and Pinia state management, and Naive UI framework development, perfectly inheriting the original Motrix's simple and intuitive interface and powerful download capabilities, while completely solving the technical debt of Electron's old stack. The software uses aria2 as the Tauri sidecar engine, compiles static binary from the source code, supports macOS Apple Silicon and Intel native operation, the volume is only about 20MB, and the resource consumption is extremely low. Motrix Next supports HTTP, FTP, BitTorrent, Magnet links and Thunder protocol downloads. In BitTorrent mode, you can selectively download files, enable DHT, P2P exchange and encryption, and automatically synchronize the community tracker list. Users can concurrently manage up to 10 download tasks, flexibly set global or single task upload download speed limits, pause, resume, bulk operation, and delete with file cleaning.

item.title: Itsytv 1.7.0
item.description:
Mac Menu Bar Apple TV Remote Control Tool

Itsytv is a native open source app that brings Apple TV remote control to the macOS menu bar for users who need to quickly control their TV, type text, and manage playback status on a Mac. It connects to Apple TV through the same local network protocol as Siri Remote, providing direction keys, confirmation, return, home page, playback pause, and volume control, responding directly and without relying on cloud services. Users can use a compact hover panel for remote control, keyboard navigation with arrow keys, Return, Backspace, Escape, and Spacebar, and enter content in the Apple TV text box in real time. Apps showcase the cover, title, artist, and progress of your current playback, and the built-in app launcher lists installed apps, gets icons, and supports drag-and-drop sorting. Itsytv supports pairing and switching between multiple Apple TVs, automatically starting for different device memory panel locations, setting global shortcuts, and logging in.

item.title: Looq 2.0.0
item.description:
Mac Access File Preview Extension

Looq is a macOS native Quick Look enhancement built by Swift that provides users with a better file preview experience. Looq supports full GitHub Flavored Markdown rendering of Markdown files, including rich formatting support, live save update previews, KaTeX math formula rendering (inline and block level), beautiful Mermaid chart display, syntax highlighting code blocks, GitHub Alerts notifications, and emoji shortcodes, while automatically generating directory sidebars, caching remote images, and remembering scrolling locations. Looq provides syntax highlighting for over 190 programming languages, supports progressive rendering, auto-formatted JSON, CSS, XML, SVG, and plist files, configurable line numbers, custom font size weights, tab widths, and wrapping, and independently sets the light and dark themes of your code and automatically identifies languages with Shebang detection.

item.title: Stash 4.4.0-585
item.description:
Clash Rule Agent Wall Climbing Tool/Surge Same Type

Stash is a simple and powerful networking tool for macOS and iOS that supports Apple Silicon and Intel devices, taking over and processing system network traffic based on the Apple Network Extension Framework. It can redirect, block or triage connections according to rules, with YAML unified configuration management agent group, routing logic and reusable rules, suitable for advanced users who need fine-grained control over network behavior. The built-in HTTP Engine can crawl, view, and debug HTTP and HTTPS requests, show details such as protocol type, handshake time, connection time, and modify requests and responses through decryption, rewriting, and JavaScript scripting. Stash also offers web tools like SpeedTest, Route Table, iPerf, and Diagnosis to help developers, testers, and privacy-conscious users analyze app networking behavior, troubleshoot interface issues, and reduce tracking and ad traffic.

item.title: iStat Menus 7.50.3
item.description:
powerful performance monitoring tool for macOS

the most comprehensive Mac monitoring tool to date, iStat Menus is a full-featured system data collector integrated in your menu bar that provides important information on key metrics. You can get statistics on CPU load, memory load, disk usage/space, disk activity, temperature monitoring, fan sensors, battery life and cycles, weather, and more. Of course, it also supports Dark Mode. the iStat Menus weather feature gives you a quick view of current weather conditions in the menu bar, or an in-depth look at very detailed hourly forecasts and weekly weather overviews, including temperature, wind speed and direction, rainfall probability, humidity, dew point, UV index, air pressure, visibility, and more. iStat Menus can display weather information based on your current location or almost any city in the world. iStat Menus is able to notify you of a wide range of events based on CPU, GPU, memory, disk, network, sensors, batteries, power and weather, whether it's a change in public IP, a loss of internet connectivity, CPU usage exceeding 60% for more than 10 seconds, or other almost unlimited conditions. It can even notify you of the day's weather or alert you to changes in daylight saving time.

item.title: Beyond Compare 5.2.8.33052
item.description:
Code Difference Comparison Tool

Beyond Compare is a popular data comparison tool that compares folders, text files, images, and tables. It efficiently reviews discrepancies and allows you to incorporate changes with confidence. Beyond Compare is a software app for developers, system administrators, and more to compare, merge, and sync data across Windows, macOS, and Linux operating systems. It compares files and folders with simple and powerful commands, focusing on the differences that interest you and ignoring the parts you don't care about. In addition, it can combine changes from two versions of a file or folder into a single output, as well as synchronize on-premises data, FTP sites, and cloud storage. The upcoming BC5 release will include new features such as dark themes, text wrapping, and more. Beyond Compare integrates FTP sites, cloud storage, and compressed files, with powerful filters that let you see only what you're interested in. It intelligently selects the best way to compare and display specific files. Text files can be viewed and edited with syntax highlighting and comparison rules for documents, source code, and HTML.

item.title: Bartender 7 Pro 7.2.0
item.description:
macOS Menu Bar Manager

Bartender is a menu bar management tool for macOS that has long focused on helping users organize, hide, and control menu bar items so that icons are only displayed when needed, reducing visual distractions and improving day-to-day operational efficiency. Bartender 7 has been redesigned for the next generation of macOS to provide smoother menu bar interaction, Command Bar keyboard command bar, menu bar item search, clipboard history, shortcuts, triggers, and mouse-free access. Users can automatically display specific items based on power status, network environment, meeting scenarios, or other conditions. They can also create different menu bar configurations and bind shortcuts, display settings, and automation rules. The new Bartender Bar supports standalone themes, uses glass, color, gradients, rounded corners and other appearance styles, and can handle bangs area occlusion. The software also supports custom spacing, tags, separators, symbols, emojis, and custom menu bar items, combining built-in data sources and scripts to perform common operations, giving the menu bar a combination of cleanliness, readability, and personalized control.

item.title: Ember 1.6.9
item.description:
Private life diary software

Ember: Journal & Life Archive is a private logging tool that combines diary and interpersonal memory archives for iPhone, iPad, and Mac. When writing down daily, just mention a person in the text, and the relevant content will be gathered on the other person's personal page, gradually presenting the common experience, the time of acquaintance and the context of contact; You can also organize people by circles, such as home, work or campus, and use stories to record chapters of life that span many years. Dynamic retrospectives reimagine old memories on the right dates and gently remind you to keep an eye out for people you haven't been in touch with for a long time. The software provides calendars, maps, and people maps to help you navigate through life's snippets from dates, places, and networks, as well as support for searching text throughout your archives and photos. You can add photos, videos, voice memos, Apple Music songs, and weather, and import Day One, Apple Journal, and contacts. The diary is saved on the device and can be locked with Face ID, Touch ID or password and synced privately via personal iCloud;

item.title: Reflow 26.8
item.description:
Multi Instrument Sheet Music Editor

Reflow is a powerful score and fingerprint editor designed for guitar, bass, drum, piano and many other musical instruments. It has been trusted by thousands of musicians around the world for more than ten consecutive years. It provides an intuitive visual keyboard input interface to support the fingerprint editing of string instruments (such as guitar, bass, banjo, ukulele) (including chord diagrams, bends, brushstrings and other effects), standard pentagram notation (including large spectral tables, cross-spectral wiring and other advanced functions). ), professional drum chromatography (supports tremolo, flam, drag, etc.), built-in high-quality Apple native rendering engine and synthesizer for instant playback, monorail/mute, loop segment, shifting exercise, real-time editing, core functions are completely free and watermark-free, subscribe to the premium version to permanently unlock watermark-free PDF export, 128 GM tones, multi-track music score display, metronome, playback speed control, MIDI keyboard input, etc., all data Local storage and support iCloud synchronization, no networking, no tracking, no account, compatible with Guitar Pro file reading and writing, MusicXML import, PDF export printing and cross-platform sharing (iPhone, iPad, Mac are available), carefully built by independent developers since 2011, dedicated to sound...

item.title: PeakHour 6.2.4
item.description:
macOS Menu Bar Network Traffic Monitor

PeakHour: Internet Monitor is a real-time network monitoring tool for macOS that centralizes bandwidth, latency, wireless signals, and connection health to troubleshoot video conferencing issues, slow downloads, network outages, and poor broadband performance. The software displays Mac, router, and carrier-to-Internet connectivity paths through menu bars and visual dashboards, helps determine where performance bottlenecks lie, and enables monitoring of UPnP or SNMP-capable routers, switches, and NAS. Built-in speed measurement combines download speed, upload speed, and rpm responsiveness ratings, and you can also see actual performance against your broadband plan. Wi-Fi analytics identifies weak signals and distractions, while historical charts make it easy to look back at traffic, delays, congestion, and disconnections. Apple Intelligence-based network consultants can rate connections, explain questions and advise in plain English, and require a Mac that supports that capability.

item.title: Noted 7.2
item.description:
AI Meeting Recording Tool

Noted is the ultimate voice recording + smart note-taking artifact for students and professionals (supports iCloud sync across iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Watch devices), featuring high-definition noise reduction recording, accurate audio/video to text conversion, multilingual voice input, fast timestamp note positioning, advanced playback of smart skip mute and noise, reminder review/meeting/exam, custom theme, beautiful widget one-click recording, safety lock pen Memorize, iCloud/PDF/TXT/M4A/web links easily share and other powerful features, so users do not have to worry about missing any key details, just focus on the current content, whether it is capturing the focus of the lecture or organizing the minutes of the meeting, it can be organized and efficiently retrieved, is an indispensable all-round recording note companion to improve learning and work productivity, providing 7-day free trial, monthly subscription, annual subscription and one-time lifetime purchase options (depending on the price) varies by region).

item.title: OpenVox – Local Voice AI 3.0.0
item.description:
Mac native offline AI speech transcription tool

OpenVox is a native speech-to-text AI text-to-speech application designed for Apple Silicon Mac that transforms arbitrary text into natural, fluid, expressive speech, running entirely locally, without the need for networking. OpenVox adopts a privacy-first design concept. All voice generation and processing are done through MLX acceleration on Mac. It supports M1 to M4 series chips, enabling near-instant voice generation and optimized memory occupation. Four powerful AI models built into the app, including OmniVoice's next-generation surreal expression and context-aware speech model, Qwen3 TTS high-fidelity speech and cloning model, Kokoro's fast and stable generation model for long content, and Chatterbox's emotionally rich multilingual expression model, provide more than 300 different voices and cover more than 600 languages, including English (American and British), Spanish, French, German, Japanese, Chinese, and Indian Local, Arabic, Korean and many more minor languages.

item.title: MindNode 2026.7.2
item.description:
Mind Maps & Outlines

MindNode: Mind Map & Outline is a mind mapping and outlining app designed for the Apple ecosystem, developed by IdeasOnCanvas GmbH, that supports seamless operation across the iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Vision Pro, and Apple Watch platforms. MindNode provides an infinite canvas for users to freely capture and visualize all ideas, using the unique node well function to stimulate creativity, which is ideal for scenarios such as brainstorming, problem solving or project planning. The outline view allows users to organize and refactor ideas in a linear structure, which is particularly suitable for drafting, researching, setting agendas or learning processes, and freely switching between mind maps and outline views to meet the needs of different creative processes. The new architecture makes real-time collaboration easier than ever, allowing team members to build the next great idea together, stay up to date, and see the richness of shared documents in real time. All documents are managed directly in-app and securely stored in iCloud, enabling automatic synchronization and seamlessly merging of changes later, even when offline.

item.title: Verso 1.0.66
item.description:
Native Lightweight Word Processor

Verso Writer is a native lightweight word processor for macOS that emphasizes fast startup, focused writing, and reliable document compatibility. It opens and saves DOCX, Markdown, RTF, ODT, TXT and other common formats for collaboration between Microsoft Word, Google Docs, LibreOffice, GitHub and other workflows. The software provides compact toolbars, elegant page layout, focus mode, paperless mode, a variety of page appearance, table of contents, annotations, revisions, footnotes, header and footer, tables, images, find replacements and word count and other writing and typesetting capabilities. Markdown files can be visually edited and preserved in rich text, and code blocks support syntax highlighting; BibTeX and CSL JSON reference management can generate references in multiple formats. The app is built with SwiftUI and AppKit. It does not rely on Electron, web view or cloud account. The interface supports multiple languages. It is suitable for Mac writers who need low burden, privacy-friendly, and full-featured.

item.title: Screens 5 5.10.1
item.description:
Cross-platform remote desktop control

Screens makes it easy to remotely control your Mac, Windows computer, Linux computer, or Raspberry Pi, whether you're at home, in a coffee shop, or anywhere else in the world. It's a versatile remote desktop solution known for being fast, secure, and reliable, giving you a seamless device control experience. By installing Screens Connect, you can access your computer from anywhere in the world, and Screens also fully integrates with Tailscale, making it easy to connect to a Linux computer or Raspberry Pi remotely. The curtain mode of Screens protects your privacy, the secure connection function ensures a secure connection to the computer, and supports SSH keys to increase security. It also offers features such as accessible Mac login, display selection, clipboard sharing, session selection, and is compatible with the Raspberry Pi 5, supporting file transfers and an easy-to-use interface, while also helping friends and family through the free Screens Assist tool.

item.title: AnySearch Pro 3.6.0
item.description:
File search tool for macOS

AnySearch Pro is a fast file search and disk content analysis tool for macOS that uses smart indexing and full-text search to find files among hundreds of thousands. A global hotkey opens a floating search panel from any app, and you can search by contains, prefix, suffix, exact match or wildcard. It supports combined filters (extension, type, size, modified date, folder scope, disk source) and searches the text of PDF, Markdown, Word, Excel and PowerPoint files, highlighting matches in snippets. Results support quick preview, opening, revealing in Finder, and copying names or paths. Real-time file system monitoring keeps the index current, including iCloud Drive and external USB and Thunderbolt disks.

item.title: Day One 2026.23
item.description:
Mac Elegant Journal Tool

Day One is a legendary digital diary artifact (supports iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch cross-platform seamless use) that has won Apple's annual app award, more than 15 million downloads worldwide and has 200,000 5-star praise, redefining the way of private life recording, allowing users to safely record their lives anytime, anywhere through unlimited text, unlimited photos/videos *, audio, Markdown rich text format and other multimedia formats, with end-to-end encryption , password/Touch ID/Face ID protection, automatic backup and PDF/plain text/JSON and other export methods to ensure that 100% privacy is not leaked, while providing daily reminder notifications, unique daily writing tips, custom templates, Today review, On This Day time revisit, tags/favorites/smart search, map location view and other powerful functions to help users easily form a habit of recording, organize diaries on different topics *, always review precious memories. The ultimate choice for diarists and heavy lifestyle chroniclers looking for the ultimate in privacy, security, beauty, and a cross-device experience.

item.title: Bluebird 3.15.1
item.description:
Learning Work Focus Timing Tool

Bluebird is a time management app for learning and working that combines a pomodoro-based focus timer and to-do list to help users overcome procrastination, stay focused, and make progress. Its main features include a flexible focus timer, a simple yet powerful task management tool that supports recording time, background sound provisioning, interference blocking, and widgets on the home screen and lock screen. In addition, Bluebird supports live activity on Dynamic Island, syncs via iCloud between iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, and Mac, and ensures accessibility (like VoiceOver and Dynamic Type). It also has full focus support, SharePlay features, Siri shortcuts, and automation. The app adheres to a strict privacy policy and does not collect user data, making it suitable for students, remote workers, or anyone who wants to use their time wisely. Bluebird also offers an Apple Watch version that keeps you focused without your iPhone, while providing instant sync, vibration alerts, and more.

item.title: Clocker 26.20
item.description:
Mac Time Zone Converter

Clocker is a world clock and calendar tool that runs on the macOS menu bar for users who regularly communicate with friends, colleagues, or customers overseas. It supports searches for thousands of cities, streets, and time zones, and can add multiple locations to a menu bar or custom panel to help users quickly see the current time, date, and time difference in different regions. The app provides a time slider that visually previews past or future times, and determines cross-time zone meetings and event schedules in conjunction with calendar events. Users can add notes and custom labels for time zones, set reminders for specific time zones, view sunrise and sunset times, and improve operational efficiency by using shortcuts, swiping on the trackpad, and copying all the time. Clocker supports Google Calendar and Outlook Calendar integration to view upcoming schedules, create calendar events, and quickly join meetings in a dashboard. It also provides a desktop widget, a floating clock, multiple themes, a dark interface, a time zone abbreviation display, time sorting, preference import and export, and multilingual support for telecommuting, international collaboration, online events, and travel planning.

item.title: Vidnip 2.0.8
item.description:
macOS Web Video Sniffer Downloader

Vidnip is a video download and media management software for Apple Silicon Mac that supports macOS 14 and above, combining web video detection, download, format conversion, and local playback in one app. After pasting the page link, the software can identify MP4, WebM, HLS/m3u8 and dash videos through traffic monitoring. Combined with the yt-dlp engine, it covers more than 1800 sites, automatically downloads segments in parallel and merges them into a playable MP4, supporting image quality selection, breakpoint continuation, batch link processing and channel update subscription. The built-in video library organizes content by source, filters unwatched items and remembers playback progress; The music library supports audio extraction, album and artist browsing, tag management, and scrolling lyrics. The subtitle feature supports downloading site subtitles, exporting text, and generating subtitles or lyrics using native speech recognition on macOS 26 and above. With the iPhone app, you can also sync music, transfer videos, play back, and remotely send download links.
